english_translation: The journey itself is long, but we will eventually arrive.
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'Rwendo' establishes the noun class/subject frame (Mupanda 11 (ru-) Labialized Prefix (rw-)).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'hedu' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (Ø- (Cl. 5/9) + -hedu (root)) with tone contour H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
